question: Which places are said to grant accomplishment related to Viṣṇu?
premises: The bank of the Gaṇḍakī is named.
Both are said to grant Viṣṇu accomplishment.
inference: The bank of the Gaṇḍakī and Dvārakā grant accomplishment related to Viṣṇu.
plain_english: The bank of the Gaṇḍakī and Dvārakā grant accomplishment of Viṣṇu.
